about_the_game: Try the demo of Radiant Exodus and jump into the chaos of Gleam City. You play as Sarah, a former soldier caught in a mutant invasion after a UFO crashes downtown. Shoot your way through the madness and get a feel for the action, and intense gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
